items.title: 19.1.2 Chemical Composition and Organization of Chromosome (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of chromosome composition and packing (PDF 117-118).

blocks.text: Chromosome taqreeban 40% DNA aur 60% proteins (histones) se bana hota hai. Dono chromatids mein bilkul aik jaise DNA molecules hote hain. Aik aam insani chromosome ka DNA taqreeban 5 cm lamba hota hai aur is mein taqreeban 140 million nucleotides hote hain. Phosphate groups ki wajah se DNA par negative charge hota hai. Histone proteins par positive charge hota hai, kyun ke un mein arginine aur lysine jaise basic amino acids zyada hote hain; is liye DNA aur histones aik doosre ko mazbooti se pakarte hain (strong affinity).
